verdict.rationale: Weave's own built-in signals automatically classify agent interactions and surface failure modes inside the product, and LLM-judge scorers produce model-based assessments of outputs. Together these are a thin form of in-product, AI-derived insight. The MCP server and Skills route sends data to external coding agents, which is a user-side arrangement and earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit evidence that in-product insights are AI/LLM-generated, any in-product suggestions or recommendations, a natural-language insight or assistant feature inside the Weave UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
out-of-the-box signals to surface failure modes
Evaluate your agent’s or application’s responses using LLM judges and custom scorers
